# COMMITTEE ON PUBLIC SAFETY, HEALTH & TRAFFIC
## May 5, 2026 at 6:15 PM

Chairman Vincent called the meeting to order.

The Clerk called the roll.

Present: Aldermen Vincent, Goonan, Dexter, Barry, Bonilla

Messrs.: C. Dobbins

1. The Traffic Division has submitted an agenda which needs to be addressed:

**STOP**
- On Overland Street at Bellevue Street, NW Corner
- *Alderman Burkush*

**HANDICAP PARKING ONLY**
- On Cedar Street, north side, from a point 30 feet east of Union Street to a point 25 feet further east
- *Alderman Bonilla*

*On motion of Alderman Barry, duly seconded by Alderman Bonilla, it was voted to approve.*

2. Communication from Caleb Dobbins, Highway Chief Engineer, advising the committee on the conversion of the South Willow Street/Sheffield Road intersection to an all-way stop condition.

Caleb Dobbins, Highway Chief Engineer: The department just wanted the board and whatnot to be aware because the intersection of Sheffield Road and South Willow Street has been a matter of attention for a number of years. The State of New Hampshire had done a road safety audit out there, probably 4 or 5 years ago now. It qualified for a HSIP project that is currently ongoing, the design within DOT. In the meantime, however, as with the road and safety audits, there are certain short, long, medium, intermediate term things that can go on in the meantime. One of those was the conversion of Sheffield from two way to one way, going from South Willow Street to Harvey Road. And now the state will be implementing a three way stop there, where South Willow Street will have a stop condition. This is informational. We within the DPW certainly hasn't looked at this in terms of what issues that may cause. Obviously, it's a fairly high traffic roadway, so folks having to stop at a stop sign at 2:00 in the morning when there's nobody there, we don't know about unintended consequences or anything like that that might come up. Nor do we know whether or not it could also ultimately affect the long-term solution that may end up coming for that intersection. So, we really just wanted the board to be aware of it. There was a presentation a number of years ago to the board by the DOT. So, we also just weren't certain whether or not the board might be interested in having the state come back and explain where that project actually is or not. So, these may not even be implemented this year supposedly.

Alderman Vincent: You'll keep us abreast if anything comes up?

C. Dobbins: That we shall.

There being no further business, on motion of Alderman Goonan, duly seconded by Alderman Dexter, it was voted to adjourn.

A True Record. Attest.

Clerk of Committee

Meeting Start Time: 6:15PM
Meeting End Time: 6:17PM
Minutes Prepared By: Michael Intranuovo
headline: Approved a stop sign on Overland Street and handicap parking on Cedar Street; heard update on Sheffield Road/South Willow Street stop conversion.
summary: The committee voted to approve a stop sign at Overland Street and Bellevue Street and handicap parking on Cedar Street. The Highway Chief Engineer gave an informational update on the state's plan to convert the South Willow Street/Sheffield Road intersection to an all-way stop, with no action taken.
decisions: Approved the STOP sign on Overland Street at Bellevue Street, NW Corner, and the HANDICAP PARKING ONLY zone on Cedar Street, on motion of Alderman Barry, seconded by Alderman Bonilla.
